notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Dear players![/b]

[h3]Today we have published another update within these few days of the release. 

There have been many voices from you saying that the game is developing too fast for some while others had absolutely the opposite opinion. 
[/h3]

[b]Therefore, one of the most important novelties in this update is the difficulty levels!
There are 3 levels : 
[/b]
[b]Easy:[/b]
[list]
[*] Buying additional store space is cheaper
[*] Expanding the parking lot is cheaper
[*] Customers are rarely in a bad mood
[*] Employees are less likely to take their salaries
[*] No thieves
[*] Customers are happy to choose products, regardless of the margin
[*] Store equipment is cheaper
[*] The level of the store grows faster
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Normal:[/b]
[list]
[*] The price of additional store space is standard
[*] The cost of expanding the parking lot is standard
[*] Customers are sometimes in a bad mood
[*] Employees are paid hourly wages
[*] Thieves appear occasionally
[*] The customer's choice of product depends partly on the margin
[*] Store equipment has standard prices
[*] Store level is growing at a standard rate
[/list]

[b]Hard:[/b]
[list]
[*] Purchasing additional store space is more expensive
[*] Expanding the parking lot is more expensive
[*] Customers are more often in a bad mood
[*] Employees are paid hourly wages
[*] Thieves show up more often
[*] The customer's choice of product is more margin-dependent
[*] Store equipment is more expensive
[*] Store level is increasing at a standard rate
[/list]

New players from the very beginning of their adventure with our game will be able to choose the difficulty level in our game, [b]while players who have started the game before will be able to choose the difficulty level after updating and firing up their in-game save! :)[/b]


[h3]This is not the end of the news that we have prepared for you, but others will appear successively in the coming days and weeks.[/h3]



[b]Patch notes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Added difficulty levels
[*] Added options to disable waving customers to cashiers
[*] Products on the way after saving and loading will go out again, so you won't lose them
[*] Fixed fish animations
[*] After skipping the night, the time is closer to the opening of the store
[*] Fixed product stuck over the bag if the product was not scanned beforehand
[/list]



See you soon,
Pet Shop Team

notes.title: New animals
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Pet Shop Fans! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re excited to see you in the first devlog since the release of Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue! 🤩 Once again, we’d like to thank everyone for trying the Prologue version and all the feedback we’ve received from you thus far. It gave us a lot of insight into what expectations you’ve got for the game and we’re currently doing our best to make the best use of what you’ve told us! 👍

With that being said, there’s a lot to be done before the release of the full version (which will happen soon… 😏) Lots of technical work on top of the changes you’ve suggested as well as creative work such as creating models. 

Prologue allowed you to see some of the animals but just as we promised, there are more available in the full version and today you can take a look at more of them!

[b]-turtles
-hamsters
-mice
-rabbits
-fishes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/60eadd3c8d7c3caea3dc33fbeccc6c639ea6888d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/475a488c603f9502e6945284adcf116d31038a8e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/077e54db907500703bb423f6478fbaff55d5d2fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/580874b6a1fbaab2d2b5b5121e2b39093b4f8f7e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/3250c6153a3825773c6cdee2850e2cb8986519f0.png[/img]
Those of you who already played the Prologue know very well that the animals need regular care. Keeping the cages clean and the pets well-fed is a bare minimum but some additional belly scratches or petting will surely not go unnoticed! 🐢

We’d also like to share a new object- a [b]self-service cash register! [/b] This new item will undoubtedly help to save time and relegate the work power to other important areas of the shop. 💰

These checkouts will sometimes require either you or one of your employees to approach and authorize the purchase. This situation is indicated by a red diode over the register. 🔴 Keep in mind that the longer you make them wait for authorization, the more likely it is to make him upset and leave the shop without buying anything.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/2d4c0ed27c39bc7768bda8daf06a71751d46b55c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/fd306ceebe055a0f8708ad463c0c80d379476c23.png[/img]
We hope you’ll enjoy the addition of this object and put it to good use. Don’t forget to let us know in the comments if you have any suggestions or ideas! You can also join our discord or add the game to your wishlist  to get notified about every important information! 👇

See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Animals in shop
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

We appreciate you agreeing to visit our shop after closing. Usually, there’re lots of people wandering around and it would be hard to introduce you to one of the most important aspects of your work in the Pet Shop- [b]taking care of the animals[/b]! 🐰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/d5f94246203fc6309d9791e75b565fd9e5790b05.png[/img]
During your shifts one of the tasks will be taking care of the needs of the animals. 📝 Make sure they’re in great condition and stay happy with help of three basic actions:
[b]-feeding
-petting
-cleaning the cages[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/b6caf990b5531ef77046e9ec1fbff33d72a921d1.png[/img]
The importance of an animal's mood is not to be underestimated. If you neglect your duties, after a while a sad face over the animal will appear 🙁 and it will impact the people coming to your shop. They’ll not be interested in buying neglected animals and what’s more, they’ll give negative opinions to the shop which will result in a drop in reputation. We don’t have to remind you what it means for your earnings, do we? 🤔 That’s why you have to make sure you’ll always remember to take good care of your animals no matter how many duties you may have.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/02e4401cce0f80c476a6f4740e49f4b4474f40b4.png[/img]
At this point you might be wondering what animals will you be able to sell?  Well, we suppose you could get a little insight into that. Amongst all the possibilities you may sell:
[b]-rabbits
-fishes
-hamsters
-turtles
-mice[/b]

We’re wondering if you have any guesses about what other animals will be available? Let us know in the comments! 👍

[h3]As always we’d love to hear your suggestions and ideas, so make sure to join us on our discord and add the game to your wishlists on Steam so you won’t miss out on any information![/h3]

notes.title: Shoplifters
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Pet Shop Players! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h3]Welcome back to the new Pet Shop Simulator Devlog. Today we’d like to talk about the living nightmare of each and every shop owner- [b]shoplifters[/b]  🤯 [/h3]

Not every customer comes to your shops to buy something  💰  there will also be individuals focused on looting your place under your nose. At first glance they’ll not be any different from every other guest visiting your store… don’t let them fool you!

[h3]As soon as the thief arrives next to the shelf he’d like to steal from, one will perform a pose which we’d like to call “thief gesture” which you can see on the screen below. 👇[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/be765a38367bafbf9f697e3974bd290609de69da.png[/img]


This is an indicator that something has just been stolen and you have to take immediate action to stop the thief! 🚨 If this is the beginning of your journey as a shop manager in Pet Shop Simulator, you’ll have to stop the thief by yourself. You can do it by clicking on him and starting an interaction. This action may have two possible outcomes:

If the person indeed stole something, police will be called to take the individual to the police station and the stolen product will be back in your shop ✅

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/76bfe9f1a5a953622efedbb4d949dd33979200a1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/0fe6e4f9b90ce61686ba8ac628670a4d1753fb42.png[/img]

[b]If the person was innocent and you point them as a thief, they’ll be mad and the overall rating of your store will take a blow  ❌[/b]


[h3]
This mechanic inclines players to watch their shops carefully. Don’t be afraid- we’re not leaving you without any countermeasures! Once you’re a bit more experienced shop owner with enough money to afford extra personnel, you’ll be able to hire a store security guard and gates with sensors. Let’s take a closer look at these options 🙂[/h3]

[b]Gates[/b] will make sound the moment a shoplifter leaves the store which can be a good last resort measure to help you catch the thief 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/09c224b3eca640e8d6a78f5f8c79697c96356484.png[/img]


[b]Security Guard[/b] will approach the thieves on his own, punish them and call the police but [b]only when he’s able to spot them[/b]! 🧑‍✈️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/4be7bbefaf44694637d36843ed0a0aa73184e32b.png[/img]


[h3][b]We suggest using both of those countermeasures for the best effect! [/b][/h3]



Let us know in the comments what you think about the shoplifting mechanics in our game. If you have any suggestions, would like to see something added, don’t hesitate to let us know! As always, we’d like to invite you to join our discord community and to add the game to your wishlists on Steam!

tags.feature: As soon as the thief arrives next to the shelf he’d like to steal from, one will perform a pose which we’d like to call “thief gesture” which you can see on the screen below.
If this is the beginning of your journey as a shop manager in Pet Shop Simulator, you’ll have to stop the thief by yourself.
If the person indeed stole something, police will be called to take the individual to the police station and the stolen product will be back in your shop ✅
If the person was innocent and you point them as a thief, they’ll be mad and the overall rating of your store will take a blow ❌
Once you’re a bit more experienced shop owner with enough money to afford extra personnel, you’ll be able to hire a store security guard and gates with sensors.
Gates will make sound the moment a shoplifter leaves the store which can be a good last resort measure to help you catch the thief
Security Guard will approach the thieves on his own, punish them and call the police but only when he’s able to spot them! 🧑‍✈️

notes.title: Day and night cycle
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re always happy to have you back with us. Today, we’d like to show you a new feature added to the game. We’d like to give you a bit more diversified gameplay experience, so we decided to add the [b]day and night cycle[/b] to the game. ☀️🌕 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/eb0abebf41ef3e47661bd1a55a82ba773259b2b6.png[/img]
The cycle will diversify your gameplay with some spare time to spend on different activities. 
At 9PM there is a 1 hour long transition from day to night. The reverse happens at 6AM and also takes an hour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/e49a2e2075ab323745d477670d0c66c289679de7.png[/img]
At the beginning of your gameplay, you’ll be able to have your shop open from 8AM to 4PM but as you progress, you’ll earn enough points to buy prolonged opening hours, at first to 7PM, eventually prolonging it to a 24h open.

When the shop is closed, you can use the spare time to clean the cages or shop, restocking the supply, buying new shelves, redoing the shop and more! 📝 Once you’re done with the changes you can choose to skip the night and move right to the opening the next day! 👍

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/cddb1d8ad1295ce50996e60a55de6c48139ad92c.png[/img]
Keep in mind that those changes can also be performed during the day but when you want to refurnish the shop while the shop is open, it’ll require you to see all your guests out and manually close the shop before doing it. 🙁

[h3]As always we invite you to add the game to your wishlist and to join our discord community! 👇[/h3]

See you soon
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Employees
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Today we’d like to talk about two certain workers we’ve introduced you to in the previous devlogs. Those particular workers have a unique power of greatly impacting your sales and as the first one, we’re talking about none other than the [b]“human directionals”[/b]. That’s right- the arrow guy! ↗️ 

[h3]His sole purpose is to encourage people to come to your store. [b]Hiring him increases the attractiveness of your store and as a consequence, the chance a passerby will decide to enter your shop.[/b] 💰[/h3]

His power of convincing people is highly relevant on his ability level. If he doesn’t know his way with the advertisement he’ll be a poor asset and often drop it. On the other hand, the highest level allows him to spin it like a pro. 💪 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/f38d2f9f8f9e7a1fc18a57f758e28556fbadc129.gif[/img]
[h3]Let’s move to the other pillar of your shop's earnings. [b]The customer service worker[/b] will work on sealing the deal. Whenever one of your customers wonders about buying any particular good, this worker will approach and try to convince the person to buy it. 👍 [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/237c55eef29e22e497edb3caba10b717f4c428ec.png[/img]
[b]His success rate as well as the persuasion force is strictly dependent on your employee’s skill in the profession[/b]. On top of that, he can easily find any product your shop has to offer if the client wants it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/83f73d0007c198213e3d1fe17b491bf349590a30.png[/img]
Don’t forget, no matter how good this employee is, you will always have the strongest persuasive force as long as you can complete the client convincing minigame successfully. 📝

That’s it for today, we’re glad you’ve joined us again in another devlog. We’d like to invite you to join us on our discord 👇 as well as to add the game to your Wishlists on Steam to not miss on any future devlogs and announcements! 💝

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/

See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team

notes.title: Shop management
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello Managers! 👋[/b][/h1]

Some of you wondered how much of a choice and control you’ll have as the owner of the pet store… With today’s devlog we’ll hopefully shed some light on this topic! 💪

[h3]First of all, we’d like to not force you to sell anything you don’t want to. Therefore, we’ve implemented an absolute freedom in the assortment. 🙂 If you dream of a shop only selling cat food- no problem! You can decide to sell only this particular product. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/710839d6743d12dcaa233732463467d6ce70ecc4.png[/img]
Though, it may not be the best strategy to maximize profit. As we’ve already mentioned in the previous devlogs part of the clients coming into the shop will look for particular items and inform you about it. 📝 If the item they’re looking for is not available they’ll leave your shop and you earn nothing. That’s why one of the challenges awaiting you will be facing clients’ requirements and ensuring diversity of offered goods in the limited space your current business offers. 🤔

[h3][b]The products you’ll be able to sell can be divided into categories, some of which are:

-food 🥫
-cages
-toys 🧸
-leashes, suspenders, collars 
-hygiene and healthcare ➕
-accessories (fur brushes etc.) 
-small animals 🐭[/b][/h3]

Keep in mind these are not all of them and more will be available later in the full version of the game! 🐹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/8179483bf5e702e94f32768b0f9835ae70c0cffe.png[/img]
The process of ordering the products is pretty simple and straightforward. All you have to do is to add the products you’re interested in buying to the shopping cart and then press order. After a short while a truck 🚚 will arrive and deploy your order on a euro palette in the upload zone in front of the store. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/05c2ce7769464d52101274a311ef83816a3190b3.png[/img]
[h3]Once the order is there, you can click on the boxes to unload them automatically onto the storage shelves. Of Course first you need to have them. If you don’t have enough space, the palette will remain in the upload zone without a way to unpack it. 😥[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/8371ecbe27d8acc1ba8210cbbc7d63802b32f7e7.png[/img]
If the player has space on store shelves for certain items which have been ordered, the storage worker will automatically start restocking the shelves with the items. If not, you have to designate what has to be on a particular shelf by putting the first commodity by yourself. After that as soon as the designated item appears in the storage, the shelf will be restocked automatically. 

[h3]We’d like to remind you about the possibility of expanding your store. This will offer you a solution to the lack of space and allow you to offer more variable goods! 🤩[/h3]

[b]Let us know what you think about this aspect of our game! We can’t wait to hear from you on our discord 👇 or in the comment section. If you’d like to support us, we’d love you to add Pet Shop Simulator to your wishlist! 👇[/b]

notes.title: Employees
notes.content:
[h1][b]Welcome back! 👋[/b][/h1]

[h2]We are happy to see you again visiting our Pet Shop! 🙂[/h2]

[h3]Last month, we’ve mentioned an important aspect of our production. [b]Your business cannot be successful without competent, skilled employees[/b] to help you run it! 👍 Professional customer service, restocking the shop or advertising, [b]good employees[/b] will help you do it [b]faster, better and cheaper[/b]. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/108f13158f2938c3ddd36c70ed2e5c141b2478d9.png[/img]
As we’ve already said you’ll be able to hire employees. They’ll have [b]different professions[/b] such as cashier, cleaner, warehouseman, customer assistant or live advertiser 📝

You’ll be able to [b]hire as many people as you want [/b]👱(as long as you don’t go bankrupt 😅) and customise their outfit’s colour. Each employee will have a different profession they’re proficient with and you’ll be able to send them for training so they can become even better at that job. 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/55cf85462700dd67c1f49a5fd84ea2b1b4c5879d.png[/img]
[h3]Each of the workers will have their own duties and responsibilities:

💲 [b]Cashier[/b] - cashier customer service 

🧹 [b]Cleaner [/b]- keeping the shop nice and clean 

📒 [b]Warehouseman[/b] - restocking shelves and ordering the products 

ℹ️ [b]Customer service[/b] - helping the customers who can’t find the item they’re looking for and approaches clients suggesting them the products they may be interested in 😀

💁 [b]Live advertisement[/b] - a real hypeman your shop needs- works outside the shop and encourages people to walk into the shop! 💪
[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/12ab8c41a3b8849ccc5a95bf97d6101abce8fe0c.png[/img]
[h3]Let us know what other professions do you think should be added in the future! 🤔 [/h3]

Don’t forget to[b] add this game to your wishlists and join our Discord community[/b] 👇 as this helps our game gain visibility and what’s more important, motivates us to keep working hard ❣️

notes.title: Cash register & employees
notes.content:
[b][h1]Hello Managers! 👋[/h1][/b]

[h3]The brand new [b]cash registers[/b] finally arrived! Therefore, we’re ready to introduce you to the new mechanic- [b]customer service as a cashier[/b]. 👍[/h3]

From now on the players will not only be in charge of taking care of the shop but also point the clients towards the items they’re looking for, advise them (as we’ve mentioned in the previous devlog) and scan the products of their choice at the cash register.

[h3]Once the client chooses all the products they’re interested in, they’ll create a line near the cash register and wait to pay. Players will have to [b]scan the products and receive the money[/b], as well as give the change if needed. 💵[/h3]

[b]As the time passes, the lines will get longer and clients will lose patience.[/b] In case they wait for too long, they’ll simply leave the items next to the cash register and leave without buying anything… This will generate mess and what’s even worse- lack of income! 🙍

[h3]As always, [b]the bigger shop, the more clients it has[/b] and naturally the lines become bigger. It’s a promise of either, huge income or an even bigger mess at the cash register… This is where[b] the employees [/b]come in handy! 🤩[/h3]

[h3]The workers will be able to take charge of the cash register and perform this task continuously without the interference of the shop owner. 🙂[/h3]

[h2][b]Players will be able to hire the workers from the very first day of the gameplay but keep in mind, they’ll generate expenses which can hinder your growth, everything has its price. 🤔[/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=3T8w9UeppM8;full][/previewyoutube]
On top of that, as we’ve explained in the previous devlog, there will be few different kinds of clients. We’d like to show you a little insight into the works on their animations- which proceeds smoothly! Below, you can see two different animations of a client who looks for something! As you can see, they are quite suggestive! 👏

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44009134/3c2936c38025316ab32ac4e3ba3c3ae6ff6eed0b.gif[/img]
That’s it for today! Don’t forget to join our discord 👇 and let us know your opinions and suggestions about the contents of the game! 🤩 If you haven’t already, add this game to your wishlists 👇 to not miss on any further update!

See you soon,
Pet Shop Team
